title: Abort handling (sender + receiver)
description: Implement SCHC abort handling for both sender and receiver. Acceptance: generates abort messages, handles received aborts, cleans up state.

Added malformed/trailing/non-FF/reserved-Rule shared vectors, schema coverage, cross-session cleanup tests, and authenticated Rust tombstone tests. Green: Python abort/fragmentation 61 passed; Rust lichen-schc all-features 116 tests plus docs passed; cargo check no-default-features; clippy -D warnings; rustfmt; ruff.
